svg.title: Scale Explorer · scale drawing
svg.desc: Each line represents its stated dimension. Dashed dimension lines are distances, not object diameters. This compares lengths; it does not map positions, areas or volumes. Keep my recorded 1.23 m height. Literal drawing. Model length = real length × 1.12 × 10⁻⁹. One model centimetre represents 8.94 × 10⁶ m. Jupiter: 1.43 × 10⁸ m · across → 160 mm You: 1.23 m · tall → 1.38 × 10⁻⁶ mm The Earth: 1.27 × 10⁷ m · across → 14.3 mm 10 mm calibration ruler Print at 100% scale. Check the 10 mm ruler with a real ruler; fit-to-page printing changes the dimensions. Each line represents its stated dimension. Dashed dimension lines are distances, not object diameters. This compares lengths; it does not map positions, areas or volumes. Dashed locators mark dimensions below 0.5 mm without enlarging them.
